summary: Central US Lookouts lists a Fox tower in Leclede County under Mark Twain National Forest. No other source found describes it.

facts.status_note: No source we found says whether the tower stands.

evidence.supports: Tower is listed in Leclede County under Mark Twain National Forest
evidence.quote: Missouri Lookouts - Leclede County - Mark Twain National Forest

notes_for_editor: No story written. The only source is a page that gives a name and a location code (33N-13W-21). A story from it would be well under the 120-word floor. Two WebSearch queries, a Living New Deal query and Wikipedia's Ozark region list of MDC areas found no Fox record. The brief's coordinates (37.5559, -92.3781) are unchecked. Needs a second source (for example a Mark Twain National Forest record or a lookout inventory) before a story is written.
